actual_schema.cutoff_proof: Outbox.verify returns summary fields plus events (integer count) and head_sha256; no head.seq wrapper and no resolution timestamp.

tables.config: body BLOB; constructor requires one exact canonical config
tables.emissions: id, batch_id, ordinal, body, state, lease, outcome

requirements.advice: Accept only a physically complete, separately pinned snapshot image with bounded exact bytes/SHA, absolute nonsymlink regular-file path and stable inode/stat. Reject WAL, SHM and rollback-journal sidecars; do not open the live database with immutable=1. Open the supplied immutable image read-only/query-only, or deserialize independently hash-checked immutable bytes into owned memory. Recheck custody before/after reading and immediately before publication. A cutoff is a dated snapshot, never proof of the latest live head. A plain copy of a running WAL main file is not a complete physical snapshot.

Use the unchanged verifier on an object created via __new__ with only a read-only/private connection. Never call Outbox.__init__, which sets WAL PRAGMAs, creates tables and may insert config. Never add indexes to the supplied image; any performance index belongs only to private memory. verify() owns BEGIN/COMMIT, so respect its no-open-transaction precondition.

Verify the complete event/ACK/materialized state, not only SQL-filtered training successes. Require exactly one config row matching the pinned config and exact expected verifier proof/head. Pin the image SHA as well as the event head: the event chain does not cover config. Refuse malformed/extra schema state and preserve a complete census of selected, duplicate and excluded rows/reasons. Keep SQL/read/JSON/file/row/output bounds and finite wall plus monotonic deadline.

Outbox.verify checks chain linkage and materialized agreement but does not replay record_batch or finish schema validation. Independently enforce their closed keys/types/ID derivation for selected rows: config/model origin; batch ID/campaign/checkpoint/manifest/global step; ordinal/emission ID and batch embedding; emitted training subset and disjoint validation membership; raw program SHA; success outcome fields/exact wrapper ref/error=None. Reject duplicate JSON keys and bool-as-int where integer identities/bounds are required.

Require phase=training, source_kind=flywheel_variant, input descriptor Context identity and current inherited partition=train, exact parent lineage and admitted descriptor, context membership in both train_data_run_ids and emitted_train_data_run_ids, and exclusion from validation_data_run_ids. Join these to a separately pinned authoritative admitted manifest/role proof rather than trusting a copied emission field. Skip validation/native/pending/unknown/failed rows without numeric substitutes; a completed failure-custody row is not success.

Pin actual verifier implementation/dependency closure and canonicalizer identity; checking only a callable code filename or a truthy returned passed flag is insufficient. Structured return must bind the selected body/outcome, exact wrapper VersionId/SHA/bytes, Context, canonical program SHA and evaluation key, and all seven named artifact refs/verified bytes with native/Rust parity and canonical score-row closure. Keep raw emitted-program hash and canonical program hash distinct; request_identity uses canonical DSL. Do not resolve mutable latest references or replace missing artifacts by running GP.

Emit exact verified program-result wrapper refs for later pinned compose, plus source cutoff and per-emission provenance. Do not synthesize q, rank, weights or CE eligibility. program_gate.verified_measurement returns teaching_eligible=False; native_variant_snapshot.compose performs the later verified mean-baseline label conversion and still disables variant CE. Export receipt should explicitly retain optimizer_updates=0, optimizer_admission=false, teacher_promotion=false.

Deduplicate by full Context/evaluation key/canonical program identity, not raw program text or emission ID. Repeated cached/published aliases should carry one result ref while retaining every contributing emission/batch/phase/cutoff provenance. Conflicting wrapper refs or mismatched semantic verifier results must fail closed unless an explicit version-equivalence policy is supplied; never silently choose newest or count a cache hit as a fresh evaluation.

A source batch outbox ACK is durable before forward/backward/optimizer and before planner commit. Outbox-only export may correctly name the generation checkpoint and proposal event, but cannot certify the originating optimizer batch committed. Keep rows unadmitted and defer that proof join, or require a separately pinned committed batch/planner census. Do not equate exported references, published measurements, admission, or later physical target consumption.

Do not reject a historically successful resolved result merely because its old lease expires before export now, and do not retry historical leased/unknown work. The source events contain no resolved_at field, so do not claim independent timestamp proof of resolution within lease; retain original lease and exact successful cutoff as historical custody.

scope: Static existing outbox/cutoff/result-reference advice before exporter source review. No approval of an implementation or live target admission.
